about: The names the network may look up once the DNS policy blocks the rest (S68 audit finding 14; dns-policy.bicep). Each entry is a name or a zone ending in a dot, and covers every name under it. Read from three days of staging's lookups (S78, 30 Sep to 3 Oct 2026). A zone is listed only if its own name servers are Microsoft's or GitHub's, so a lookup under it can't carry data to anyone else's server; names Microsoft picks and changes (storage accounts, the cluster's API host) are allowed by their zone. The policy's dns-allow rule refuses any Allow not listed here.
